display_name: Verify RGB-D Image Content and Alignment

agent_discovery.description: Validate one synchronized RGB-D bundle by checking its actual grids, frame timestamps, registered-depth boundary, shared-memory route, numeric edge correspondence, and a VLM review of the RGB, registered-depth, and overlay image content. Use this read-only Skill before metric registration when image presence alone is insufficient.
when_to_use: RGB, depth, IR, or registered depth may have different resolution, aspect ratio, boundary, timestamp, or frame rate.
A spatial or motion-related operation needs evidence that registered depth depicts and aligns with the RGB scene.
The operator requests visual inspection of RGB-D content rather than a file-presence check.
when_not_to_use: No synchronized RGB-D bundle or registered-depth product is available.
A historical validation is being treated as proof for a new camera boot or calibration revision.
side_effects: Reads one synchronized shared-memory RGB-D bundle.
Writes local RGB, registered-depth, and composite diagnostic images.
Calls one configured VLM route with bounded fallback.
Does not move hardware or publish a motion-usable transform.

request.description: Why the current RGB-D alignment must be validated.
